admission.justification: Row validation (shaped rows pass, empty uses fail) is proved by the named passing row-gate cases; single-test-file member of the family.

applicability: Every registered tool and every task_doc operation.
conditions: Each row states answerable fields with caller uses, ordinary/largest static cases or named production derivation paths, its bound and interim ownership.
Bounds are ceilings set from the largest case; interim rows carry bound 4000 with no fields.
exclusions: Interim rows, which carry no field list until their leaf lands.
Harness-side cuts, which the product does not govern.

evidence: mcp/tests/test_tool_answer_table.py::ToolAnswerRowGateTests (passing in the R6 run) including test_valid_shaped_row_passes and test_empty_use_fails

statement: One table row per registered tool and per task_doc operation holds the fields an answer may hold with each field's caller use, measured ordinary/largest case payloads and exact interim ownership; missing authored rows fail and shaped rows validate their cases.
